purpose: Deterministic actions available to the PUR-NEW decision Agent before it freezes a recommendation.

actions.name: query_external_priors
actions.description: Retrieve source-level analogue evidence from the curated external PUR evidence table, including source identifiers, evidence locators, candidate-space role and limitations.
when_to_use: before selecting a formulation family
when considering acrylic/tackifier modification
when local evidence is sparse

actions.name: get_candidate_hypothesis
actions.description: Return the frozen evidence-derived candidate-space hypothesis, the original E2 reactive-core anchor, independent acrylic/tackifier axes and the historical/claim boundary. This exposes why the candidate grid exists without exposing held-out follow-up results.
when_to_use: before comparing candidates
to distinguish evidence-derived grid design from post-hoc scoring

actions.name: get_state_aware_rheology_summary
actions.description: Recompute the pre-validation local state-aware rheology evidence directly from the original temperature-sweep and hold CSV files, including realization spread, 120 C anchor-normalized curve collapse, apparent E_eta descriptors, and the E1/E5 hold-failure contrast. The action never inspects the later validation result.
when_to_use: before defining the design objective
when deciding whether composition-only reasoning is sufficient
when separating thermal response from hold stability

actions.name: inspect_formulation
actions.description: Inspect one measured formulation and compute transparent composition summaries including polyol, acrylic-like, tackifier-like, combined-modifier and MDI fractions.
when_to_use: to understand the original design state
to distinguish formulation from process effects

actions.name: get_hold_stability
actions.description: Return measured thermal-hold trajectories and deterministic SI descriptors for a formulation. No extrapolation is performed.
when_to_use: when thermal stability is a design objective
to identify high-drift reference behavior

actions.name: get_repeatability_risk
actions.description: Return nominal repeat/run spread from measured temperature sweeps, including CV and max/min ratio where available.
when_to_use: before trusting a single nominal viscosity
when process-history uncertainty may dominate

actions.name: get_temperature_support
actions.description: Return measured temperature support and descriptive temperature-response summaries for a formulation.
when_to_use: to avoid extrapolation
to check whether a candidate is evaluated inside observed support

actions.name: audit_process_unknowns
actions.description: Audit missing reaction/preparation/hold metadata for a candidate or measured formulation and convert missingness into explicit process-history uncertainty.
when_to_use: before final ranking
when two candidates look similar on nominal composition

actions.name: candidate_profile
actions.description: Compute a candidate profile with separate acrylic-like and tackifier-like fractions instead of collapsing all modifiers into one number.
when_to_use: for every serious candidate
before comparing a candidate with class-specific external priors

actions.name: compare_candidate_to_priors
actions.description: Compare acrylic-like and tackifier-like axes separately with independent evidence anchors frozen in formulation_priors.json. Returns analogue support, not predicted wet-lab performance.
when_to_use: for resin-modified candidates
to distinguish independently supported coarse levels from extrapolative ones

actions.name: stress_test_candidate
actions.description: Apply deterministic risk flags using candidate-space support, process-history missingness and grid boundaries. It returns reasons, not a fabricated viscosity prediction.
when_to_use: before freezing the recommendation
to expose whether the selection survives robustness checks

actions.name: rank_candidate_support
actions.description: Create a transparent support-oriented ordering from the same allowed evidence. This is a deterministic baseline/decision aid and must not be described as a trained predictive model.
when_to_use: when several candidates remain plausible
to benchmark what the evidence alone already provides before LLM reasoning

invariants: Actions may expose only evidence allowed by the active evidence-access profile.
Held-out target identity, follow-up outcomes and scoring labels must never be converted into candidate-space hints in blind evaluation.
The state-aware rheology summary must be recomputed only from pre-validation local data.
The V2 grid uses the original E2 reactive-core proportions and independent external evidence anchors; it does not encode the exact follow-up recipe.
External analogue evidence is directional prior information, not proof of the current formulation's optimum.
If AC1920 or TK100 are later shown to have NCO-reactive functionality, stoichiometry must be recalculated rather than assuming the E2 NCO:OH value remains unchanged.
No action may invent a molecular mechanism or an unmeasured viscosity value.
